_about: Dated events and reinforcements (RULES.md §4, §10) [balanced]. Each event has a 'month' (or 'from'/'to' with optional 'months' of the year), a 'name', a 'text' for the log and 'effects' the engine applies (see docs/DATA.md for the kinds). A 'choice' event asks one side to pick an option; the computer picks 'aiChoice'. Reinforcements arrive in the nation's rear column (placeLanes limits where); 'afterEntry' months count from the USA's declaration of war. A 'telegram' {title, text, meaning} is what the event telegram says (docs/STYLE.md §6); 'once: true' sends it only the first month a repeating event happens. Each choice option's 'telegram' is sent when the computer picks it. Events with no effects are notices only.

events.name: First gas attack
events.text: Chlorine at Ypres: Germany's first attack in lane 2 this month gets +2 columns.

telegram.title: GAS AT YPRES
telegram.text: German troops have released chlorine gas against the line north of Ypres.
telegram.meaning: Germany’s first attack in lane 2 (Ypres) this month gets +2 columns. After that one attack the surprise is gone.

events.name: Blockade
events.text: The British blockade bites: Germany −1 Will.

telegram.title: THE BLOCKADE BITES
telegram.text: The Royal Navy’s blockade is starving Germany of food and raw materials.
telegram.meaning: Germany loses 1 Will every other month through December 1916. Harder years follow: the Turnip Winter in 1917, then hunger in 1918.

telegram.title: THE TURNIP WINTER
telegram.text: The potato harvest has failed. German families are living on turnips.
telegram.meaning: Germany loses 1 Will every month of 1917.

telegram.title: HUNGER IN GERMANY
telegram.text: Rations in German cities have fallen below what a man can work on.
telegram.meaning: Germany loses 2 Will every month of 1918. Time is against Germany.

events.name: Creeping barrage
events.text: The creeping barrage: up to 3 munitions per attack from now on.

telegram.title: THE CREEPING BARRAGE
telegram.text: The gunners have learned to walk their shells forward just ahead of the infantry.
telegram.meaning: From now on an attack can use up to 3 munitions (+3 columns) instead of 2.

events.name: The U-boat decision
events.text: Germany must decide how to wage the U-boat war.

options.label: Unrestricted
options.text: Britain −2 Will a turn for 6 turns, but the USA declares war in April 1917.

telegram.title: UNRESTRICTED SUBMARINE WARFARE
telegram.text: Germany has declared unrestricted submarine warfare.
telegram.meaning: Britain loses 2 Will each month for 6 months. The United States will enter the war in April 1917; its troops follow 7 months later.

options.label: Restricted
options.text: No extra pressure on Britain; the USA declares war in January 1918.

telegram.title: U-BOATS HELD BACK
telegram.text: Germany will keep to the prize rules at sea.
telegram.meaning: No extra pressure on Britain. The United States will enter the war in January 1918; its troops follow 7 months later.

telegram.title: THE U-BOAT DECISION
telegram.text: The German Admiralty asks for permission to sink every ship in British waters without warning.
telegram.meaning: Germany must choose. Unrestricted warfare hurts Britain but brings the United States in sooner.

events.name: The Hindenburg Line
events.text: Germany may fall back to the new Hindenburg Line.

choice.question: Fall back to the Hindenburg Line?

options.label: Fall back
options.text: Give up G1 in lanes 5–8; G2 there becomes trench 3; +2 German rail moves this turn.

telegram.title: GERMANY FALLS BACK
telegram.text: Germany has withdrawn to the Hindenburg Line.
telegram.meaning: The German front line in lanes 5–8 is given up to the Entente. The line behind it is now trench 3, and Germany has 2 extra rail moves this month.

telegram.title: GERMANY HOLDS
telegram.text: Germany has decided to hold its present line.

telegram.title: THE HINDENBURG LINE
telegram.text: A new, deeply dug line of concrete and wire is ready behind the Somme and the Oise.
telegram.meaning: Germany must choose whether to give up the front line in lanes 5–8 and fall back to it.

events.name: Vimy and the Dominion corps
events.text: The Canadian and Australian corps: two British units become Elite.

telegram.title: VIMY RIDGE
telegram.text: The Canadian Corps has stormed Vimy Ridge. The Dominion troops have proved themselves.
telegram.meaning: Two British infantry units become Elite for good: +1 column when they attack.

events.name: Russia leaves the war
events.text: Revolution in Russia: Germany +10 Will. Divisions start to come west.

telegram.title: RUSSIA LEAVES THE WAR
telegram.text: The Bolshevik government has signed an armistice with Germany.
telegram.meaning: Germany gains 10 Will. German divisions from the East arrive in January, February and March 1918.

events.name: Stormtroopers
events.text: Germany retrains up to 4 infantry units as Stormtroopers.

telegram.title: STORMTROOPERS
telegram.text: German assault battalions have been trained to infiltrate, bypassing strong points.
telegram.meaning: Up to 4 German infantry units become Stormtroopers: when they attack a trench, one trench shift is cancelled.

events.name: The Kaiserschlacht gamble
events.text: Germany made no attack between April and October 1918: −15 Will.

telegram.title: THE GAMBLE LOST
telegram.text: Germany let the summer of 1918 pass without an offensive. The Americans are here in force.

events.name: The Kaiserschlacht
events.text: Germany must attack by October 1918 or lose 15 Will.

telegram.title: KAISERSCHLACHT
telegram.text: Divisions freed from the East give Germany one last chance to win before the Americans arrive in force.
telegram.meaning: Germany must make at least one attack between April and October 1918, or lose 15 Will at the start of November.

events.name: German exhaustion
events.text: The German army is exhausted: all Entente attacks get +1 column from now on.

telegram.title: THE BLACK DAY
telegram.text: At Amiens whole German divisions have given way. Influenza and hunger are breaking the army.
telegram.meaning: German exhaustion: every Entente attack gets +1 column from now on.
